decisions.reason: Having survived the early post-launch review when several adjacent 2018 products were removed, this service appears to meet aspiration levels better, uses the firm's core fibre capabilities, and fits its move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure.

This portal also survived the initial cull and supports the firm's push toward more automated provisioning, but because it is tied to the more mature voice domain and could be absorbed into broader service platforms, its discontinuation risk is higher.
